page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.2-32 is a compute instance within the Optimized family, driven by Intel Xeon 6354 processors operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server allocates 2 physical cores, translating to 4 dedicated vCPUs at 2 threads per core. System memory provides 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB memory allocation per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is not included, with a GPU count of zero. The instance has no local storage drives, requiring persistent storage workloads to rely entirely on external network-attached block volumes. Network configuration provides 1 complimentary public IPv4 address.

From a hardware-efficiency perspective, the 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation allows memory-heavy applications to run without provisioning unneeded processor cores. This configuration targets workloads such as in-memory caches, relational database hosting, memory-constrained data transformation pipelines, and general enterprise backend workloads.
